messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Replace old strings if needed. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Use natural light, capture front, back, side, headstock, and any unique features or damage. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of returns. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Look at similar models, age, condition, and brand. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and avoid over‑ or under‑pricing. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, any upgrades, and why you’re selling. | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, buyer protection.
• **eBay** – wide audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local Music Stores / Pawn Shops** – quick sale, but usually lower offers.
• **Consignment** – store sells for you, takes a commission. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use multiple if you want speed. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target price to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point keeps you from underselling. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local Pickup** – no shipping costs, safer for both parties.
• **Shipping** – use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with insurance and tracking. | Shipping adds cost and risk; local pickup is simpler for most sellers. | | **8. Secure Payment** | • **Cash** – safest for local sales.
• **PayPal / Venmo** – secure online payments.
• **Escrow** – for high‑value items or when using eBay. | Protects against fraud and ensures you receive funds before handing over the guitar. | | **9. Prepare for Negotiation** | Be ready to explain your price, show photos, and discuss any repairs or upgrades. | Negotiation is normal; being prepared keeps the conversation professional. | | **10. Close the Sale** | Once you agree on terms, finalize the transaction, sign a bill of sale if needed, and hand over the guitar. | A formal record protects both parties and can be useful for tax or warranty purposes. | ### Quick Tips - **Avoid “Too Good to Be True” Deals** – If a buyer offers far more than your asking price, verify their identity and payment method first. - **Use a Bill of Sale** – Especially for higher‑priced instruments; it documents ownership transfer. - **Consider a Warranty** – Some buyers may ask for a short warranty period; decide if you’re willing to offer one. - **Safety First** – Meet in public places for local sales, or use a secure shipping method. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2008 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand: Yamaha - Model: FG800 - Year: 2008 - Serial: 123456 - Condition: Minor scratches on the back, no cracks, strings replaced last month. - Features: Solid spruce top, nato/okume back & sides, 25.5" scale. - Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 2015 Yamaha FG830. Photos: [Attach 5–6 images] Price: $350 (Negotiable) Payment: PayPal or cash (local pickup in NYC). Shipping available with insurance. ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on marketplaces (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention local music stores, pawn shops, consignment. Provide tips for negotiation, payment methods, etc. No need to call function.
